# Final Pre-Code Plan

1. Inspect current `origin/main` and Olam status.
2. Read the real API/server/client/reference/image files and tests.
3. Compare exact current payload behavior with official MiniMax H3 V2 documentation.
4. Create a clean release worktree from the newest safe remote parent.
5. Rewrite only files proven necessary; split new responsibilities into small modules.
6. Add futuristic rectangular glass UI with minimal compositor cost.
7. Harden image replacement/update persistence and immediate preview refresh if inspection reveals gaps.
8. Correct any H3 request-contract mismatches found in the audit.
9. Add deterministic API contract tests for every local Olam endpoint and every generation mode.
10. Run file-limit, tabs, syntax, unit, API-contract, and performance-oriented browser gates.
11. Test local mobile screenshots/geometry and reference-image update flows in Chrome.
12. Fast-forward push only after remote race check.
13. Canonically deploy the exact commit SHA.
14. Verify every public Olam API route, assets, status, and both browser suites in production.
15. Record evidence and return the completed live URL only after production proof succeeds.
